key.name: last-open-dir
key.summary: Last used directory for the Open dialog
key.description: The absolute filesystem path of the last directory successfully used in the Open File dialog. When set and valid, the dialog will start in this directory to improve user experience.

key.name: heading-format
key.description: Format to use when exporting headings to markdown. 'atx' uses # symbols, 'setext' uses underlines for H1 (=) and H2 (-) with ATX for H3-H6.

key.name: autosave-enabled
key.description: When enabled, the application will automatically save changes every few seconds to prevent data loss. When disabled, only manual saves will occur.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Width of the main window in pixels. Automatically saved when the window is resized and restored on next launch. Minimum 600px for usability.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Height of the main window in pixels. Automatically saved when the window is resized and restored on next launch. Minimum 400px for usability.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the main window was maximized when last closed. Restored on next launch to maintain user's preferred window state.
